fine_lines.title: worried vs stressful
fine_lines.explanation_ar: worried تصف شعور الشخص (أنا قلق)، و stressful تصف الشيء المسبب للتوتر (الامتحانات مجهدة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Worried" describes how you feel. "Stressful" describes the thing.

fine_lines.title: study vs practice
fine_lines.explanation_ar: study تعني تتعلّم وتقرأ عن موضوع، و practice تعني تكرّر شيئًا لتتحسّن فيه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Study = learn about something. Practice = do it again and again to get better.

expressions.phrase: How do you feel about the upcoming exams?

grammar.title: Giving advice with imperatives
grammar.explanation_ar: نقدّم النصيحة بالأمر (الفعل في أصله في أول الجملة): Write down all the subjects. Take short breaks. والنفي: Don't be afraid. Don't forget to take breaks.
grammar.explanation_en: Give advice with imperatives: Take breaks. Negative: Don't be afraid.
examples: First, write down all the subjects you need to study.
Take short breaks to relax and recharge.
Don't be afraid to ask for help.

grammar.title: Present perfect: Have you made one? — Not yet.
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل هل حدث شيء حتى الآن: Have you + التصريف الثالث؟ والجواب: Not yet (ليس بعد) أو Yes, I have.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask: Have you + past participle? Answer: Not yet / Yes, I have.
examples: Have you made one? Not yet.
Your advice has made me more confident.

grammar.title: Sequence words: First, Then
grammar.explanation_en: Use First... Then... to order steps.
examples: First, write down all the subjects.
Then, decide which ones are the most difficult.
Start with easy problems and move on to harder ones.
